No Hostel accommodation will be provided and selected candidates will have to make their own arrangement during their training as per Apprentices Act. 1961 and they will be released on completion of the training.

how_to_apply: Visit the official RCF Kapurthala website: www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in
Locate the online application link for Act Apprentice engagement and follow the detailed instructions provided on the website.
Register and fill in personal details and bio-data carefully, ensuring the name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match the matriculation certificate.
Upload a scanned passport-size colour photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, taken within the last 3 months, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 kb–70 kb, without cap or sunglasses).
Upload a scanned signature (3.5cm x 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 kb–30 kb).
Review all entered details, since no changes or edits are allowed after fee payment.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- online (if applicable) within 2 working days of completing the form, using the payment link provided.
Submit the application and save/print the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is payable only through the online payment gateway (debit card, credit card, internet banking, SBI challan, etc.) integrated with the application form; cash, cheque, money order, or demand draft are not accepted. Payment must be completed within 2 working days of successfully filling the application, and no edits are allowed once the fee is paid. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination.

content_sections.heading: RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Salary/Stipend
content_sections.text: As per extant rules & directives issued by Railway Board from time to time. No Hostel accommodation will be provided and selected candidates will have to make their own arrangement during their training as per Apprentices Act. 1961 and they will be released on completion of the training.

content_sections.heading: RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list, without any written examination or interview, prepared as follows: The merit list is based on the simple average of the percentage of marks in matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) and the percentage of marks in the ITI/NTC certificate for the relevant trade. Matriculation percentage is calculated using marks obtained in all subjects, not just a selected group of subjects. In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is preferred; if the date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is preferred. A final merit list is prepared trade-wise and community-wise, in descending order of marks, equal to the number of available seats. Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification, where original certificates and a medical fitness certificate are checked. Call letters for document verification may be issued to up to 1.5 times the number of identified slots. Selected candidates must also be found medically fit as per the standards prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RCF Kapurthala website: www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in Locate the online application link for Act Apprentice engagement and follow the detailed instructions provided on the website. Register and fill in personal details and bio-data carefully, ensuring the name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match the matriculation certificate. Upload a scanned passport-size colour photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, taken within the last 3 months, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 kb–70 kb, without cap or sunglasses). Upload a scanned signature (3.5cm x 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 kb–30 kb). Review all entered details, since no changes or edits are allowed after fee payment. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- online (if applicable) within 2 working days of completing the form, using the payment link provided. Submit the application and save/print the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Rail Coach Factory (RCF), Kapurthala, under the Ministry of Railways, to engage 734 Act Apprentices for training in nine trades under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, as per Notice No. A-1/2026 dated 07.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 734 vacancies are available across nine trades: Fitter, Welder (G&E), Machinist, Painter (G), Carpenter, Electrician, AC & Ref. Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), and Electronic Mechanic.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 05.09.2026, up to 24:00 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th class (or equivalent) with at least 50% aggregate marks and hold a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the relevant trade issued by the NCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 15 and 24 years of age as on 05.09.2026, with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, PWD, and Ex-servicemen candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100/- (non-refundable), payable online only. SC, ST, PWD, and women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website, www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in, by registering, filling in the application form, uploading photograph and signature, and paying the fee (if applicable) within 2 working days.
